section.title: Turning a pasted list into grocery items
section.scenario: The grocery app lets someone paste a list from their notes, one item per line, and adds each line as an item. About 3% of lists are started this way. The team has talked about importing recipe ingredients one day, with quantities and units, but it has no date and no design yet.
section.question: Both pieces add the same items from the same pasted text. Which cost should the app pay now, and which stated facts decide it?
section.piece_a:
class PastedList
  def initialize(text)
    @text = text
  end

  def items
    @text.to_s.lines.filter_map do |line|
      name = line.strip.delete_prefix("- ").strip
      { name: name, quantity: 1 } if name.present?
    end
  end
end
